scope: Known-displacement development controls for adaptive patch reliability. No real-capture trial or application modification.
baseline: Existing 65-pixel local translation matcher at the same patch centre.
method: Fit translation-gradient and brightness/offset terms to the aligned image residual, aggregate residual scores into 8-pixel spatial blocks, and form a cluster covariance for the fitted gradient coefficients. This is approximate, not a calibrated displacement confidence interval.

protocol.rule: Smallest accepted size with cluster standard error <=0.10 px and linear correction <=0.15 px. Keep fixed 65 if none qualify.
protocol.gate: Selected displacement RMS must improve over fixed 65 overall and must not worsen by more than 5 percent at any tested sampling. No real-capture test if this fails.
protocol.warning: Approximate error diagnostic; not a calibrated confidence interval.

first_rule.decision: Reject smallest sufficiently precise: noise-only translation controls worsen overall and at every sampling scale.

protocol.rule: Largest accepted size agreeing with every smaller valid estimate within three combined cluster standard errors plus their linear-fit corrections. Reject corrections above 0.15 px; keep 65 if no valid size. Test translation and spatially varying motion at fresh seeds.
protocol.gate: Selected displacement RMS must improve over fixed 65 overall and must not worsen by more than 5 percent at any tested sampling. No real-capture test if this fails.
protocol.warning: Approximate error diagnostic; not a calibrated confidence interval.

second_rule.gate_application: Require improved aggregate RMS separately for translation and deformation; no individual sampling group may worsen by more than 5 percent.
second_rule.decision: Reject coarsest statistically compatible: aggregate improvements hide 12.0% and 16.4% deformation regressions at half and native sampling.

decision: Retain production matcher. Do not run a Jupiter pilot or tune confidence thresholds from these inspected controls. Adaptive sizing needs evidence of motion-model bias as well as random uncertainty.
limitations: Analytic continuous scenes and independent Gaussian detector noise, with a noise-free reference; not a complete atmosphere/detector model.
The covariance measures fitted gradient coefficients and does not include all subpixel-interpolation bias or nonlinear/model-mismatch error.
Residuals caused by real varying motion can increase the apparent uncertainty and conceal disagreement between patch sizes.
Small-sample spatial block covariance has not been calibrated as a confidence interval.
These are isolated patch-centre controls; no final-image improvement is claimed.
